findings.highlight: a plate full of steamed meat dumplings
findings.evidenceJa: 何を考えているのか皿一杯のシューマイ軍団
findings.governingReading: One platter holds an absurd full army of shumai.
findings.explanation: The English gives the food generically and drops the comic “army” image and narrator’s incredulous aside.

findings.highlight: some stir-fry of an elegant looking meat I’ve never seen before with vegetables
findings.evidenceJa: なんか見たこともないような上品そうな肉と野菜の炒めもの
findings.governingReading: Another platter holds an elegant-looking meat-and-vegetable stir-fry unlike anything Shirou has seen.
findings.explanation: The English makes the meat itself unknown and elegant-looking, misattaching the description of the unfamiliar dish.

findings.highlight: when I told that her no one at our house cooks Chinese
findings.evidenceJa: けど中華料理は誰も作らないって言ったら
findings.governingReading: Sakura says that when she told Rin nobody in the household cooked Chinese food, Rin volunteered to make it.
findings.explanation: The English word order is grammatically malformed.

findings.highlight: Why does she have to live her life poking at holes?
findings.evidenceJa: なんでそう隙間を突くような人生しか送れないのかアイツは
findings.governingReading: Shirou jokes that Rin can only live by finding and exploiting every open niche.
findings.explanation: The literal “poking at holes” is non-English and loses the competitive opportunism of the joke.

findings.highlight: I am pleased to receive an honest response like that.
findings.evidenceJa: 先生のように素直に感想を言ってもらえると、わたしも嬉しいです
findings.governingReading: Rin says she is pleased when someone gives an honest reaction the way their teacher does.
findings.explanation: The English omits the explicit comparison to Fuji-nee, weakening Rin’s response to her particular personality.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka Rin looks at me with an expression of triumph.
findings.evidenceJa: 性根の曲がった遠坂凛
findings.governingReading: After smiling at Sakura, the “crooked-natured” Rin turns a triumphant look on Shirou.
findings.explanation: The English omits Shirou’s comic judgment of Rin’s character, leaving only the surface expression.
